illustration.description: Flat cartoon style with bold dark-brown outlines and soft cel shading. A worried teenage boy with short brown hair, a teal hooded sweatshirt, khaki pants and white sneakers stands upright on the left, looking sideways with a sad, sweaty expression and a single tear. Beside him, a tall yellow wooden measuring ruler with brown tick marks rises from a light blue ground shadow, its top curling over, with a gray question mark floating above it. To the right, a glossy yellow warning triangle with a brown exclamation mark sits in the air, surrounded by small golden sparkles. Clean white background with a soft pale blue ground shadow under the figures.

graphics.description: Dashed yellow arc curving up and over the top of the ruler, suggesting the boy's height being cut off, with small blue-gray motion dashes near the boy's head
